name: Claude Opus 4.6
note_long: Small penguin, simple scene, a thin mast with a wing. No propeller, no remote. Next to Opus 5.5 this is the clearest generation gap in the test.

note.en: Tiny penguin on a bare stick. No motor, no remote.
note.ru: Крошечный пингвин на голой палке. Ни мотора, ни пульта.
